tasks.short: Analyse operational problems and improve procedures

steps.what: Gather and verify facts about operational problems, theft concerns and wastage
Compare problem patterns and investigate plausible causes
Establish corrective procedures and check whether they alleviate the operational problems

tasks.design: Configure simple summaries of verified waste and stock observations in {BI} or the existing {SPREADSHEET}. The supervisor investigates causes and establishes procedures; the view does not label staff as responsible for theft.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeatedly grouping observations can obscure operational patterns.
tasks.enabler_now: Waste recording and analytical products exist; a basic grouped view needs no model.
tasks.still_hard: Separate recording errors, process problems and genuine misconduct without unsupported attribution.
tasks.human_edge: Listen to explanations and choose workable changes.

ambition.what: Review verified wastage patterns between formal operational reviews.

tasks.altitude: The supervisor sees patterns sooner while retaining investigation and procedure decisions.

reach.task: Adjust production procedures based on verified waste
reach.learn: Distinguish recorded patterns from causal evidence

evidence.claim: Orbisk records food waste; the digest reports a Novotel case of reduced waste, not a measured labour saving for this analytical task.
Grouping verified records can reduce repeated manual comparison; this local labour hypothesis is unmeasured.

assumptions: Supervisor produces event_date, item, quantity, unit, observation_source and any confirmed process category in s1, including checking existing records and manually capturing gaps; all its 35% remains.
Existing kitchen staff produce original waste and stock records during their work; this design leaves that effort unchanged and assumes no new camera or reason-code feed.
Missing or inconsistent units remain excluded from numerical summaries until manually resolved. S2 includes entry checks and interpretation; only repeated grouping is reduced.
Test native reports first; no individual staff ranking or automated misconduct inference is introduced.
unknowns: Whether existing records have comparable quantities and units
research_questions: Does the grouped view reduce comparison time after validation and missing-data capture are counted?

incremental.description: Maintain summary categories and report misleading patterns

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional E1: B=100; R=35+25.5+35=95.5; gross=4.5%; minus 1 focal upkeep gives 3.5% net. Low: records are inconsistent or already summarised. High: repeated grouping shrinks; gathering, cause judgement and corrective procedures keep their effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Greet and seat guests and present menus

steps.what: Greet guests and clarify party size and seating needs
Seat guests and present menus and wine lists

tasks.design: Retain direct greeting, table choice and menu presentation. Existing menus and the supervisor’s observation of available tables are sufficient for this task; no new seating automation is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work involves hospitality and physical assistance.
tasks.enabler_now: No new digital capability justifies removing the interaction.
tasks.still_hard: Accommodate accessibility needs and changing table readiness.
tasks.human_edge: Make guests welcome and notice assistance they need.
tasks.altitude: The supervisor keeps the same guest-facing responsibilities.

reach.learn: Ask about access and party requirements

evidence.claim: Greeting, accompanying guests and presenting menus remain direct service work.

assumptions: Supervisor establishes needs in s1 and observes actual table availability in s2; no free live readiness feed is assumed.
Management supplies current menus under its existing process, unchanged outside this task.
No new application or upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Which accessibility needs and seating constraints apply
research_questions: Which seating problems most often need supervisor help?

incremental.description: No new seating system to maintain

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=35+65=100. Guest interaction, table observation and physical assistance remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review new products against intended use and supplier information
Trial products and evaluate usefulness and suitability for the operation

tasks.design: Keep product trials and suitability judgements with the supervisor, retaining supplier specifications in {DOCS}. A summary of a specification cannot establish how a product performs in the kitchen or service setting.
tasks.previous_blocker: Suitability depends on real use and local operating constraints.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing specifications and samples support evaluation; no additional model is required.
tasks.still_hard: Judge quality, safety, usability and operational fit together.
tasks.human_edge: Notice practical problems absent from supplier descriptions.
tasks.altitude: The supervisor retains evaluation and recommendation rights; no purchasing authority is added.

reach.learn: State clear trial criteria and record limits

evidence.claim: Practical product suitability cannot be established solely by summarising supplier documents.

assumptions: Suppliers provide existing samples and specifications; supervisor checks their relevance and gaps in s1 rather than assuming structured verified specifications.
S2 includes actual trial and judgement. Subsequent procurement or recipe changes are outside this task.
No new digital process creates incremental upkeep.
unknowns: Which products and trial constraints apply
research_questions: Which product claims require an actual trial before a recommendation is justified?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=35+65=100. Specification review and practical evaluation retain full effort; no untested substitution of documents for trials is counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Compile and balance shift cash receipts

steps.what: Collect shift receipts and count actual cash by denomination
Compile cash receipts and compare counted cash with expected cash
Investigate differences and sign off balanced cash receipts or documented exceptions

tasks.design: Use the existing {OTHER} restaurant POS shift-close screen to enter counted cash and compare it with recorded cash transactions. Retain physical counting, receipt checks, discrepancy investigation and sign-off; no new saving is claimed for arithmetic already present.
tasks.previous_blocker: Differences can reflect missing receipts, count errors or unrecorded movements.
tasks.enabler_now: Native POS reconciliation is already available in many operations and should be checked before adding software.
tasks.still_hard: Explain differences without silently adjusting figures to force a balance.
tasks.human_edge: Follow evidence and escalate unresolved exceptions.
tasks.altitude: Reconciliation and escalation responsibilities remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: POS close screens commonly compare entered cash counts with recorded transactions; local capability must be confirmed.

assumptions: Supervisor produces denomination counts, shift identifier and receipt completeness check in s1. Entry of the verified count, opening float and any documented cash movements is counted in s2; no free structured count is assumed.
POS transaction records arise from original bill/payment capture, unchanged outside this close boundary. Missing records require manual clarification and unresolved differences are preserved.
This is the close-and-reconcile view of work that can overlap the broader cash-handling and deposit task; its counting baseline and any future savings must not be added again in a role roll-up.
Current arithmetic and close form remain unchanged, so no new upkeep or savings are claimed.
unknowns: Who can sign off unresolved differences
research_questions: Which close exceptions remain after existing POS arithmetic is used correctly?

incremental.description: No new reconciliation system or process

approvals.approved_version: Supervisor signs exact reconciliation revision including count, shift, receipt references and unresolved differences; changed values require renewed review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=40+25+35=100. Existing calculation remains part of today’s workflow; physical count, data capture and exception checking are unchanged. This overlap with broader cash handling adds no separate saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: A verified operational summary may reduce repeated comparison while hospitality, product trials and cash reconciliation remain accountable human work.
reach: Provide traceable cash-close exceptions to bookkeeping
role.ambitious_version: Use factual patterns for more frequent improvement discussions without automating blame or practical judgement.
